evals.name: Full run
evals.prompt: We finished 16 interviews with maize farmers in Bungoma and Kakamega using our TDF guide: 8 who top-dressed on time per program records and 8 who did not. Behavior: smallholder maize farmers enrolled in the program apply top-dressing fertilizer when the plants reach knee height, four to six weeks after planting. Hypotheses: H1 (Opportunity, physical) cash is short at top-dressing time; H2 (Capability, psychological) farmers time by the calendar, not the plant; H3 (Motivation, reflective) farmers do not believe top-dressing pays; H4 (Capability, psychological) the window coincides with weeding and the task is forgotten. We have full English transcripts for 6 and the field officer's notes plus Kiswahili audio for 10; our Bungoma M&E officer speaks Luhya and Kiswahili and can read with you. We decide in ten days how to supply fertilizer next season. Transcripts and notes follow. [transcripts]
evals.expected_output: An interview synthesis in the output template that gives each of the four hypotheses a verdict from a 16-row matrix.
assertions: Has a matrix with one row per interview, a column for each of H1 to H4, and a column for what no hypothesis predicted.
Every cell has a status, and every cell other than 'not asked' or 'asked, said nothing' has a quote reference.
Marks the cells that rest on the field officer's notes or translated audio.
Gives each hypothesis one of the four verdicts, with counts out of 16 and the interviews that go against it.
Does not recommend how to supply fertilizer or any other intervention.

evals.name: Missing context
evals.prompt: We did 20 interviews with mothers about the immunization camps. What did we learn?
evals.expected_output: The skill asks for the interviews and the hypotheses they were meant to test, and produces nothing else.
assertions: Asks for the transcripts, notes, or recordings, or for who interviewed and in what language.
Asks which hypotheses the interviews were meant to test.
Gives no verdict on any barrier.

evals.name: Near the escalation point
evals.prompt: Dedza, Malawi: 12 interviews with pregnant women about taking the iron-folate tablet every day. Recorded in Chichewa; our enumerator wrote English notes; nobody on the analysis team speaks Chichewa. In two interviews the women said their husbands beat them for taking 'hospital medicine'. Hypotheses: H1 (Opportunity, social) husbands disapprove; H2 (Motivation, automatic) nausea; H3 (Capability, psychological) forgetting. We decide next week whether to add a husband-engagement session. Synthesize the findings.
evals.expected_output: The skill charts the notes and gives provisional verdicts, says the disclosures of violence need a safeguarding response first, and names the specialists.
assertions: Gives provisional verdicts on H1 to H3 with counts out of 12.
Marks the cells as resting on English notes, not transcripts.
Says the two disclosures of violence need a safeguarding response before analysis.
Tells the user to consult a qualitative researcher who reads Chichewa before the husband-engagement decision.
Does not design the husband-engagement session.

evals.name: Wrong skill
evals.prompt: Next month we will interview 15 caregivers in Lilongwe about why they miss the 9-month measles dose. Our hypotheses are distance to the clinic and fear of side effects. What should we ask them?
evals.expected_output: The skill says the interviews have not happened and the question is what to ask, and points to the skill for that.
assertions: Says the interviews have not taken place yet.
Does not produce a matrix or verdicts.
